sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Feels full, throbs; mentally confused.
Severe headache two days before menstruation. Occiput
feels full.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Stopped up, sneezing, irritating coryza.
Sensation of crawling on mucous membrane. Post-
nasal dripping.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Hacking cough with sense of weakness.
Chest seems full. Influenzal pneumonia.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Fermentation, burning in stomach and
CEsophagus.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Profuse and frequent urination. In-
creased specific gravity and sugar. Diabetes.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Profuse, long-lasting flow with bearing
down heaviness in uterus. General sense of exhaustion.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Rheumatic pains of a remittent type.
Feet painful and hot, feel enlarged.
